docs.title: Harborview Workspace — Now Open in the Riverside District
docs.text:
Looking for a professional place to work without the commitment of a long-term lease? Harborview Workspace offers flexible memberships designed for freelancers, start-ups, and remote teams.

Membership options:
Flex Desk — $180/month: access to any open desk, Monday to Friday, 8 A.M.–6 P.M.
Dedicated Desk — $290/month: your own desk with a lockable cabinet, 24-hour access
Private Office (up to 4 people) — $850/month: furnished office, 24-hour access, 10 free meeting-room hours per month

All members enjoy high-speed Internet, complimentary coffee, and mail handling. Members who sign a six-month agreement before June 30 will receive their first month at half price. Tours are available daily; book one at www.harborviewworkspace.com/tour.

docs.title: Subject: Membership inquiry
docs.text:
From: Daniel Okafor
To: memberships@harborviewworkspace.com
Date: June 22

Hello,

I toured your facility last Thursday and was impressed by its bright, quiet atmosphere. I run a small graphic design studio with two colleagues, and we currently work from our homes. We would like a space where we can meet clients and keep our equipment secure overnight, since one of us often works late.

Before I commit, I have two questions. First, if we need more than the included meeting-room hours, what is the hourly rate for additional time? Second, would it be possible to move into a larger office later in the year if we hire another designer?

I would like to sign a six-month agreement this week so that we can take advantage of your current promotion. Please let me know what documents I need to bring.

Best regards,
Daniel Okafor
Okafor Design Studio

questions.q: What is indicated about Harborview Workspace?
options: It handles mail for its members.
It is located next to a train station.
questions.explain: Quảng cáo ghi tất cả thành viên được hưởng "mail handling" (xử lý thư từ).

questions.q: Why did Mr. Okafor write the email?
options: To schedule a tour of the facility
To ask for information before signing up
To complain about the noise in the building
questions.explain: Trong email, ông Okafor nói "Before I commit, I have two questions" — ông hỏi thông tin trước khi đăng ký.

questions.q: Which membership will Mr. Okafor most likely choose?
questions.explain: Email cho biết nhóm có 3 người, cần gặp khách hàng và làm việc khuya; quảng cáo cho thấy chỉ Private Office (tối đa 4 người) có giờ phòng họp miễn phí và truy cập 24 giờ.

questions.q: What will Mr. Okafor's studio most likely receive if he signs this week?
options: A larger office at no extra cost
A reduced price for the first month
questions.explain: Email viết ngày 22/6 và ông muốn ký hợp đồng 6 tháng; quảng cáo nói ký hợp đồng 6 tháng trước 30/6 được giảm nửa giá tháng đầu.

questions.q: In the email, the word "commit" in paragraph 2, line 1, is closest in meaning to
questions.explain: "Before I commit" nghĩa là trước khi tôi quyết định/cam kết đăng ký, tức "make a final decision".

docs.title: Subject: Invoice #BL-40712
docs.text:
From: Priya Raman
To: care@brightline.com
Date: March 8

Dear Customer Care,

Our order arrived on schedule on March 6, and most of the items were in excellent condition. However, I noticed two problems when checking the shipment against your invoice.

First, we were charged for twelve desk organizers, but only eight were delivered. Second, one of the office chairs has a broken armrest. Our office manager has kept it in its original box.

I would appreciate it if you could send the missing organizers and arrange for the damaged chair to be collected and replaced. Alternatively, please issue a revised invoice reflecting the correct amount. We will hold payment until this matter is resolved, although I am confident it can be settled well before the deadline.

Kind regards,

Office Administrator, Marlow Accounting Group

questions.q: What is indicated on the invoice?
options: The order included a delivery charge.
Delivery is free for orders above a certain amount.
Toner cartridges are sold in boxes of five.
questions.explain: Hóa đơn ghi "Delivery fee: $0.00 (free for orders over $500)" — miễn phí giao hàng cho đơn trên 500 đô.

questions.q: What problem does Ms. Raman mention?
options: Some items were missing from the delivery.
The shipment arrived later than expected.
The paper was the wrong size.
The toner cartridges did not fit the printer.
questions.explain: Trong email, bà Raman nói bị tính tiền 12 khay để bàn nhưng chỉ nhận được 8 cái.

questions.q: By how much was Marlow Accounting Group overcharged for the desk organizers?

questions.q: What is suggested about the damaged chair?

It is a different model from the one ordered.
questions.explain: Hóa đơn cho phép trả hàng còn nguyên bao bì trong 14 ngày để được hoàn tiền; email (ngày 8/3) cho biết ghế vẫn được giữ trong hộp gốc.

questions.q: In the email, the word "settled" in paragraph 3, line 4, is closest in meaning to
questions.explain: "It can be settled" ở đây chỉ vấn đề (matter) được giải quyết, tức "resolved".

docs.title: Careers at Ventora Logistics — Regional Operations Coordinator
docs.text:
Ventora Logistics, a fast-growing freight company with warehouses in five cities, is seeking a Regional Operations Coordinator for its Da Nang office.

Responsibilities:
- Coordinate daily shipments between warehouses and clients
- Prepare weekly performance reports for the regional director
- Train new warehouse staff on safety procedures

Requirements:
- At least three years of experience in logistics or supply chain management
- Strong spreadsheet skills; knowledge of RouteMax software is an advantage
- Fluency in English; a second Asian language is preferred
- Willingness to travel to other branches up to six days per month

Applications, including a résumé and cover letter, must be submitted by October 15. Interviews will be held during the week of October 27.

docs.title: Application for Regional Operations Coordinator
docs.text:
October 10

Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to apply for the Regional Operations Coordinator position advertised on your Web site. For the past four years, I have worked as a shipping supervisor at Cao Phong Distribution, where I oversee the movement of goods for more than forty clients and produce monthly reports for senior management.

In my current role, I redesigned our warehouse orientation program, which reduced workplace accidents by 30 percent within a year. I use spreadsheets every day, and although I have not worked with RouteMax, I recently completed an online course in a similar routing program. In addition to Vietnamese and English, I speak conversational Korean.

I understand that the position requires regular travel, and I am happy to visit other branches as needed. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my qualifications during your interview week.

Sincerely,
Lin Tuyet Mai

questions.q: What is NOT listed as a responsibility of the position?
questions.explain: Trang tuyển dụng chỉ liệt kê điều phối hàng, làm báo cáo hằng tuần và đào tạo nhân viên mới; không có đàm phán hợp đồng.

questions.q: What is indicated about Ventora Logistics?
options: Its headquarters are in Da Nang.
It recently merged with another company.
It has warehouses in several cities.
questions.explain: Trang web giới thiệu Ventora là công ty vận tải "with warehouses in five cities".

questions.q: Which responsibility is Ms. Lin's work on the orientation program most relevant to?
options: Training new warehouse staff on safety
Preparing reports for the regional director
questions.explain: Thư xin việc nói cô thiết kế lại chương trình định hướng giúp giảm 30% tai nạn; trang tuyển dụng có nhiệm vụ đào tạo nhân viên mới về an toàn.

questions.q: What is suggested about Ms. Lin?
options: She has less experience than the job requires.
She lacks experience with one preferred software program.
She is unwilling to travel for work.
She submitted her application after the deadline.
questions.explain: Trang tuyển dụng nói biết phần mềm RouteMax là lợi thế; trong thư, cô Lin thừa nhận chưa từng dùng RouteMax.

questions.q: In the letter, the word "oversee" in paragraph 1, line 3, is closest in meaning to
questions.explain: "Oversee the movement of goods" nghĩa là giám sát, quản lý việc vận chuyển hàng, tức "supervise".

To: All Finance Department Staff

As you know, our company will roll out a new expense reporting system on June 1. Because our department will be responsible for approving every claim submitted through the system, I am asking all finance staff to attend the morning session on the new system rather than the other option.

questions.q: In the memo, the phrase "roll out" in paragraph 1, line 1, is closest in meaning to

docs.title: Lakeside Community Arts Center — Spring Pottery Courses
docs.text:
Discover the joy of working with clay! Our spring courses run for eight weeks, beginning April 6. Class sizes are limited to ten students so that instructors can give individual attention.

Beginner Wheel Throwing — Mondays, 6:00–8:30 P.M. — Instructor: Sofia Brandt — $240
Hand-Building Techniques — Wednesdays, 10:00 A.M.–12:30 P.M. — Instructor: Kenji Morita — $210
Glazing and Decoration — Thursdays, 6:00–8:30 P.M. — Instructor: Sofia Brandt — $260
Weekend Studio for Families — Saturdays, 9:00–11:00 A.M. — Instructor: Amara Cole — $180

All fees include clay and firing. Members of the arts center receive a 15 percent discount on course fees. Registration closes March 30; refunds are available until the first class.

From: Sofia Brandt
To: Gregory Walsh
Date: March 25

Dear Mr. Walsh,

Thank you for signing up for my course. It's nice to hear from a former student! Arriving a little late is fine; I spend the first 20 minutes of each session demonstrating a technique, and I'll be glad to recap anything you miss.

As for your earlier work, you are welcome to bring up to three pieces, provided they have already been fired once. Unfired clay cannot be glazed safely in our kilns.

Sofia Brandt

They are all taught by the same instructor.

questions.q: How much will Mr. Walsh most likely pay for his course?

questions.q: What is suggested about Mr. Walsh?

questions.q: What is NOT mentioned in Ms. Brandt's email?
options: A demonstration at the start of each session
A limit on the number of earlier pieces
A rule about glazes from home

questions.q: In the email, the word "provided" in paragraph 2, line 1, is closest in meaning to
questions.explain: "Provided they have already been fired once" là liên từ điều kiện, nghĩa là "với điều kiện là", tức "as long as".

docs.title: Local Business News — Tasty Expansion for Saffron Table
docs.text:
MAPLEWOOD (August 2) — Saffron Table, the Indian restaurant that has drawn crowds to Elm Street since 2019, will open a second location next month in the newly renovated Carver Building on Harbor Avenue. Owner Meera Joshi said the new site will seat 120 diners, nearly twice as many as the original.

"Our customers kept telling us they had to wait too long for a table," Ms. Joshi explained. "The Harbor Avenue location will also have a private dining room for business events."

The new restaurant will be managed by chef Arjun Patel, who has worked at the Elm Street location for four years. Unlike the original, which closes at 9 P.M., the Harbor Avenue branch will stay open until 11 P.M. on weekends. A grand opening celebration is scheduled for September 12, when all diners will receive a complimentary dessert.

docs.title: Saffron Table, Harbor Avenue — 4 out of 5 stars (posted September 20 by Colin Mercer)
docs.text:
I visited the new Saffron Table with three colleagues last Saturday at around 9:30 P.M., after a late meeting, and was relieved to find the kitchen still busy. The lamb curry was rich and perfectly spiced, and the vegetable biryani was generous enough to share.

The dining room is spacious and attractive, although it was rather noisy on a weekend night. Service was friendly but a little slow; our main courses took nearly 40 minutes to arrive. I suspect the staff are still settling into the new space.

Overall, it is a welcome addition to the waterfront area. I plan to return, perhaps for a quieter weekday lunch, and I would recommend reserving a table in advance.

docs.title: Subject: Thank you for your review
docs.text:
From: Meera Joshi
To: Colin Mercer
Date: September 22

Dear Mr. Mercer,

Thank you for your thoughtful review of our Harbor Avenue restaurant. I was pleased to read that you enjoyed the food, and I appreciate your honest comments about the wait.

You were right that our team is still adjusting. Since your visit, we have added two servers to our weekend evening shift, and Chef Patel has simplified the preparation of several dishes to speed up service.

As a gesture of appreciation, I would like to invite you to try our lunch menu as my guest. Please show this e-mail to your server on any weekday before October 31.

Warm regards,
Meera Joshi
Owner, Saffron Table

questions.q: According to the article, why is Saffron Table opening a second location?
options: Because the Elm Street building is being renovated
Because customers often had to wait for a table
Because its chef wanted to run his own restaurant
questions.explain: Trong bài báo, bà Joshi nói khách hàng thường phàn nàn phải chờ bàn quá lâu.

questions.q: What can be concluded about Mr. Mercer's visit?
options: It took place during the grand opening celebration.
It was possible because of the new branch's later weekend hours.
He and his colleagues ate in the private dining room.
He had previously visited the Elm Street location.
questions.explain: Bài đánh giá cho biết ông đến lúc 9:30 tối thứ Bảy; bài báo nói chi nhánh Harbor Avenue mở đến 11 giờ tối cuối tuần, trong khi chi nhánh cũ đóng cửa lúc 9 giờ.

questions.q: What is NOT mentioned in the review?
questions.explain: Bài đánh giá nói về món ăn, độ ồn và phục vụ chậm, nhưng không đề cập chỗ đậu xe.

questions.q: What has the restaurant done in response to Mr. Mercer's comments?
options: Hired more staff for busy evenings
Lowered the prices of its main courses
questions.explain: Bài đánh giá phàn nàn phục vụ chậm; email của bà Joshi cho biết đã thêm hai nhân viên phục vụ cho ca tối cuối tuần.

questions.q: In the email, the word "gesture" in paragraph 3, line 1, is closest in meaning to
questions.explain: "As a gesture of appreciation" nghĩa là một cử chỉ/món quà để bày tỏ lòng cảm kích, tức "token".

docs.title: Notice to Passengers — Coastal Line Track Maintenance
docs.text:
From Monday, November 3, to Friday, November 14, maintenance work will take place on the Coastal Line between Bayview and Port Selwyn stations. During this period, trains will not run between these two stations after 8:00 P.M. on weekdays. Instead, replacement buses will depart from the front entrance of each station every 30 minutes. Bus journeys take approximately 25 minutes longer than the train.

Daytime and weekend services will operate as normal. Passengers holding monthly passes may use replacement buses at no additional charge. Please note that bicycles cannot be carried on the replacement buses. We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience.

questions.q: Which train will Ms. Tanaka most likely take?

questions.q: In the notice, the word "holding" in paragraph 2, line 1, is closest in meaning to
questions.explain: "Passengers holding monthly passes" nghĩa là hành khách có/sở hữu vé tháng, tức "possessing".

docs.title: Pinecrest Hotel — Meeting Room Rental
docs.text:
Pinecrest Hotel offers three meeting rooms ideal for workshops, interviews, and board meetings. All rates are for a full day (8 A.M.–6 P.M.) and include a projector, a whiteboard, and bottled water.

Aspen Room — seats 12 — $350
Birch Room — seats 30 — $600
Cedar Hall — seats 80 — $1,100

Bookings made at least 30 days in advance receive a 10 percent discount on room rental. A deposit of 25 percent is required to confirm any reservation. To request a room, complete the online booking form, and our events coordinator will reply within one business day.

questions.q: Which of Ms. Ruiz's requests will NOT be provided as she asked?

questions.q: In the email, the word "secure" in paragraph 4, line 1, is closest in meaning to
questions.explain: "To secure the booking" nghĩa là để đảm bảo/giữ chắc việc đặt phòng, tức "guarantee".

docs.title: Subject: Office move
docs.text:
To: All Employees
From: Facilities Department
Date: January 9

As announced last month, Corbel Media will move to its new offices at 400 Linden Plaza. The move will take place in stages so that daily work can continue with minimal disruption. Each department has been assigned a moving date (see the attached schedule).

Before your department's moving date, please pack the contents of your desk into the labeled boxes provided by the facilities team, and remove personal items from shared areas. Computers and monitors will be disconnected and transported by our IT contractor; do not pack them yourself.

On your moving date, you are encouraged to work from home. Your new workstation will be ready by 8:00 A.M. the following morning.

docs.title: Subject: Question about our move
docs.text:
From: Leo Fischer
To: facilities@corbelmedia.com
Date: January 24

Hello,

My team received our packing boxes yesterday, and we have started preparing for the move. I have a question about our large-format printer, which we use daily to produce poster proofs for clients. It is too heavy to fit in a standard box, and I am concerned it could be damaged if it is moved carelessly. Will your IT contractor handle it along with the computers, or should I arrange a specialist mover?

Also, one of my designers, Hana Ito, is scheduled to present to a client at our current office on the morning of our moving date. Could she use a meeting room on the ground floor until noon that day?

Thanks,
Leo Fischer
Design Team Lead

docs.title: AeroBrew Pro Coffee Maker — Product Details
docs.text:
The AeroBrew Pro brews up to 12 cups in under eight minutes and keeps coffee hot for four hours with its double-walled steel carafe. A programmable timer lets you wake up to freshly brewed coffee, and the built-in grinder offers five settings, from coarse to fine.

Price: $189 (Black or Silver); Copper finish: $209
Warranty: 2 years on all parts; an extended 5-year warranty is available for $25

Free shipping on all orders. Customers who register their product online within 30 days of purchase receive a free bag of our signature roast and a replacement water filter.

docs.title: Great coffee, frustrating timer — 3 out of 5 stars (by Ananya Sen, verified buyer, March 3)
docs.text:
I bought the copper AeroBrew Pro a month ago and generally love it. The grinder is quiet, the coffee tastes excellent, and the carafe really does keep it hot all morning.

My main complaint is the timer. Twice now, it has failed to start at the time I set, so I ended up making coffee by hand before work. The instruction booklet does not explain how to reset the clock after a power cut, which may be the cause. I registered the machine online and received the free coffee, which was a nice touch, but I'd like the timer problem solved before I can give it five stars.

docs.title: Subject: Your recent review
docs.text:
From: AeroBrew Customer Care
To: Ananya Sen
Date: March 5

Dear Ms. Sen,

Thank you for sharing your experience with the AeroBrew Pro. We were sorry to learn about the trouble with the timer. You are correct that a power interruption can erase the timer settings. To fix this, hold down the CLOCK and PROGRAM buttons together for five seconds, then set the time again.

We have also noticed that some early units shipped with outdated software. Since your machine is still under warranty, we can send you a prepaid label to return it for a free update, which normally takes about a week. We realize this means going without your coffee maker for a few days, so we will include a complimentary travel mug with the returned unit.

Best regards,
Daniel Huang
AeroBrew Customer Care
